title: Probability
seo_title: Probability – JSS 2 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Find the probability of simple events; use the probability scale; find the probability that an event does not happen; list outcomes of two events. (summary of the NERDC JSS 2 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 2 maths worksheets on probability: the probability scale, probability of single events, events not happening, sample spaces and two dice. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Probability is a number from 0 (impossible) to 1 (certain).
  • P(event) = number of favourable outcomes ÷ total number of equally likely outcomes.
  • The probabilities of all the outcomes add up to 1, so P(not A) = 1 − P(A).

Examples

Example

A bag has 3 red and 5 blue balls

P(red) = 3/8

Answer: P(not red) = 5/8

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Probabilities bigger than 1Check your answer is between 0 and 1.
Not counting all outcomesList them in a table.
Adding probabilities of the same outcome twiceCount each outcome once.
